parameters.name: BackendServerPort
parameters.description: The port used by backend servers. Valid values: **1** to **65535**.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description:
The description of the listener. The description must be **1** to **80** characters in length.

> The description cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: EipTransmit
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable EIP passthrough. Valid values:

- **on**: Enables EIP passthrough.

- **off** (default): Disables EIP passthrough.

parameters.name: EstablishedTimeout
parameters.description: The timeout period for established connections, in seconds. Valid values: **10** to **900**. Default value: **900**.

parameters.name: HealthCheckConnectPort
parameters.description: The port used for health checks. Valid values: **1** to **65535**. If you do not specify this parameter, the port specified by `BackendServerPort` is used by default.

parameters.name: HealthCheckConnectTimeout
parameters.description:
The maximum time to wait for a health check response. If a backend ENS instance does not respond within this timeout period, the health check fails.

- Default value: 5.

- Valid values: **1** to **300**.

- Unit: seconds.

> If the value of this parameter is less than the value of `HealthCheckInterval`, this parameter is ignored and the value of `HealthCheckInterval` is used as the timeout period.

parameters.name: HealthCheckDomain
parameters.description: The domain name used for health checks.

parameters.name: HealthCheckHttpCode
parameters.description:
The HTTP status codes that indicate a successful health check. Valid values:

- **http\_2xx** (default)

- **http\_3xx**

- **http\_4xx**

- **http\_5xx**

parameters.name: HealthCheckInterval
parameters.description: The interval between health checks, in seconds. Valid values: **1** to **50**. Default value: **2**.

parameters.name: HealthCheckType
parameters.description:
The health check type. Valid values:

- **tcp** (default)

- **http**

parameters.name: HealthCheckURI
parameters.description:
The URI for health checks. The URI must be **1** to **80** characters in length.

> The URI must start with a forward slash (/) but cannot be only a forward slash (/).

parameters.name: HealthyThreshold
parameters.description: The number of consecutive successful health checks required for a backend server to be considered healthy (from a `fail` to `success` state). Valid values: **2** to **10**. Default value: **3**.

parameters.name: ListenerPort
parameters.description: The listener port that receives and forwards requests to backend servers. Valid values: **1** to **65535**.

parameters.name: LoadBalancerId
parameters.description: The ID of the load balancer instance.

parameters.name: PersistenceTimeout
parameters.description:
The timeout period for session persistence.

- Default value: **0**, which indicates that session persistence is disabled.

- Valid values: **0** to **3600**.

- Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: Scheduler
parameters.description:
The scheduling algorithm. Valid values:

- **wrr** (default): Weighted Round Robin. Requests are distributed to backend servers based on their weights. Backend servers with higher weights receive more requests.

- **wlc**: Weighted Least Connections. Requests are distributed to backend servers based on both their weights and the number of connections. If multiple backend servers have the same weight, the one with the fewest connections receives more requests.

- **rr**: Round Robin. Requests are distributed to backend servers in sequential order.

- **sch**: Source IP Hash. Requests are routed based on a consistent hash of the source IP address, ensuring that requests from the same source IP address are sent to the same backend server.

- **tch**: Four-tuple Hash. Requests are routed based on a consistent hash of a four-tuple (source IP address, destination IP address, source port, and destination port), ensuring that requests from the same flow are sent to the same backend server.

parameters.name: UnhealthyThreshold
parameters.description: The number of consecutive failed health checks required for a backend server to be considered unhealthy (from a `success` to `fail` state). Valid values: **2** to **10**. Default value: **3**.
